01As part of our servicing and refurbishment work, we modernised a domestic wastewater treatment plant…

As part of our servicing and refurbishment work, we modernised a BC 4 PP domestic wastewater treatment plant that had been in operation for an impressive 25 years. Likewise, the original electrical distribution board and control unit had served the whole time without being replaced. This reference project proves that even technology this old can be successfully refurbished and brought into line with current standards – without having to replace the entire plant.

02Smart refurbishment instead of replacement

Smart refurbishment instead of replacement

The customer did not have to invest in excavation work and the installation of a new unit. We chose a solution that made better sense both technically and financially – a complete refurbishment of the existing technology on site.

03What did we do?

What did we do?

  • we kept the original plastic tank, which saved both money and time,
  • we completely replaced the internal technology in line with the current EN 12566-3 standard,
  • we fixed a mechanical fault caused by a foreign object in the central zone (we found a spade there),
  • we replaced the non-functioning aeration elements, the air distributor and the outdated electrical distribution board with its control unit,
  • we repaired the disconnected air hoses and installed a warning signal light,
  • we put the system into operation, including filling it with active biological sludge.
04The result? A modern, working treatment plant without having to replace the whole technology.

The result? A modern, working treatment plant without having to replace the whole technology.

This project shows that even after 25 years an older WWTP can have new potential – all it needs is a chance and expert care. Thanks to our experience and technical facilities, we can design a tailor-made solution and bring even older types of treatment plant back to life.
